facts.fact: Coworker's own 100-task benchmark found that OM2 plus model routing cut token cost 51x.
facts.quote: In Coworker's 100-task benchmark, OM2 plus model routing cut token cost 51x.

facts.fact: Coworker's FAQ says OM2 plus model routing lowered token cost 51x versus one frontier model in its 100-task benchmark.
facts.unit: x (token cost reduction vs. one frontier model)
facts.quote: In Coworker's 100-task benchmark, OM2 plus model routing lowered token cost 51x versus one frontier model.

facts.fact: Coworker offers an optimized default plus 13 models that users can switch between.
facts.quote: Optimized default plus 13 models to switch between

facts.fact: Coworker's default 'Optimized' model is the open-weight model it rates best for cost, which it names as GLM 5.3 Flash at the time of the page.
facts.quote: Optimized, the open-weight model Coworker rates best for the cost (GLM 5.3 Flash today)

facts.fact: Coworker lists native connectors to 50+ tools with read and write access.
Coworker states it is SOC 2 Type II certified and that its audit is performed annually with the report available on request.
Coworker's security list includes SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and CASA Tier 2 compliance.
facts.quote: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, CASA Tier 2, SSO, RBAC

facts.fact: Coworker says its memory stays in the user's region and that open-source models run in the US.
facts.quote: Your memory stays in your region. Open-source models run in the US.

facts.fact: Coworker states it never trains models on customer data, with no model provider exception.
Coworker says it encrypts data with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2 or higher in transit.
facts.value: AES-256 at rest; TLS 1.2+ in transit
facts.quote: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit

facts.fact: Coworker does not publish list pricing; prospects are directed to book a demo for pricing.
The page describes OpenRouter's pricing as pay-per-token and variable.
A Coworker customer (Huuuge Games) said the team needed to save two to two and a half hours per month per person to break even on ROI.
facts.quote: We just needed to save two to two and a half hours per month per person to break even.

facts.fact: Coworker offers a 20-minute demo for comparing it with OpenRouter.
